/material/rope.name: Load, twist and counter-lay hemp rope
steps: Combine four bundles of the same yarn material into one held stack before loading an empty anchored hand ropewalk. Apply matching yarn stacks to each other to combine them. Materials cannot be mixed.
Use for 100 ticks to twist four strands under tension, then use again for 100 ticks to lay them together in the opposite direction.
Four yarn bundles represent equal-length groups of yarn, not four individual threads. Four output coils are game units.
Recover paid unfinished work by dragging the frame onto yourself. A twisted batch resumes at counter-laying.
Output is ordinary rope for existing consumers. Grass crude twine, sinew, tow twine and direct raw-plant recipes remain available.

/material/wood.name: Grow a timber tree
steps: Forage small bushes with a kitchen knife on Help intent for a chance of tree seeds, or obtain a map-placed tree-seed crate.
Stand beside an empty outdoor ploughed plot under open sky and use one tree-seed portion on it.
Water and feed the seedling through six successful minute-long growth stages. Clear obstructions and wait for a suitable climate and season.

The seedling becomes an ordinary seasonal tree. Chop the mature tree for seven logs. Uprooting a living or dead seedling requires a shovel or spade (unfold folding tools first) and returns no logs or seeds; knives and hatchets cannot uproot it.
/material/wood.conditions: One seed portion per successful planting. Outdoor ploughed space must stay clear of roofs, dense objects, living occupants and other crops. Drought and storms can kill seedlings; poor soil may delay growth. Winter pauses development but not water use. Growth progress survives saves; downtime adds no growth.
/material/wood.map_notes: Seed foraging is random and map-placed crates are not guaranteed. Tree growth requires both a declared biome and season on every map. Existing tree biomes are inherited; seasons are SUMMER, SPRING, FALL, Wet Season and Dry Season.
/material/wood.era: No additional era restriction established by this procedure.
/material/wood.status: source-reviewed proposed shovel-only update; changed uprooting native acceptance pending

/obj/item/weapon/reagent_containers/food.name: Harvest mushroom
steps: Use one seed portion on an empty ploughed plot. Herbs are planted using an herb portion.
Water and feed the crop, then wait until it is ready.
Use a hatchet, knife, bayonet or scythe on the ready crop. Collect its produce and, except for herbs, two returned seeds.
/obj/item/weapon/reagent_containers/food.conditions: Live harvest stage required. Crop is removed on harvest; yield varies with nutrition. Dead crops produce nothing.
/obj/item/weapon/reagent_containers/food.map_notes: Seed/crop placement is not guaranteed. Outdoor growth uses the climate and season rules of the selected map. /material/stone.name: Sift soil by hand or sieve
steps: Stand on uncovered non-mineable dirt or sand.
Use Crafting > Sift soil for resources, or use a held wooden resource sieve. Choose a resource.
Stay on the tile until the action finishes: three minutes by hand or two with a sieve, for one unit.
/material/stone.conditions: Renewable trace gathering. Tile must not contain covers; action must remain uninterrupted. Calamine (zinc ore) is offered from age 1.
/material/stone.map_notes: Availability depends on the selected map; placements and construction reachability were not executed.
/material/stone.era: No additional era restriction established by this procedure.
/material/stone.status: source-reviewed conditional route; gameplay/map reachability unverified

/material/stone.name: Powered soil sifter
steps: Anchor a powered soil sifter on uncovered non-mineable dirt or sand. Connect its power cable.
Run it and clear its output tile; it selects a random mineral and produces two units per two-minute cycle.
/material/stone.conditions: Requires 150 available power for active processing and inherited cable connection. Output accumulation is bounded; construction/research gates apply separately.
/material/stone.map_notes: Availability depends on the selected map; placements and construction reachability were not executed.
/material/stone.era: No additional era restriction established by this procedure.
/material/stone.status: source-reviewed conditional route; gameplay/map reachability unverified

/material/stone.name: Mine finite deposits

/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.name: Grow and harvest turnip
steps: Sow one seed in a prepared ploughed plot.
Keep the crop alive until harvest-ready, then harvest with a suitable sharp tool.
Keep spores/seeds for another planting; eat the produce or store it off the floor.
/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.conditions: temperate, sea, tundra or taiga outdoor/open-sky ploughed soil; all four ordinary seasons including winter. Each harvest retires the crop and returns two seeds/spores plus one to three food items depending on fertility; each food has two nutriment. Snowstorm protection does not remove water/soil costs, drought or sandstorm death. Normal stage progression.
/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.map_notes: Rock must be cleared then suitable dirt ploughed. Jungle dirt and Desert-map dust remain unsuitable.
/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.era: Plough: four wood planks, Basic Agriculture research rules (node tier 1); no new era gate for seed or food.
/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.status: Source-reviewed proposed extension of pinned base; native harvest/consumption/save acceptance unverified

/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.name: Grind logs into chip batches
steps: Anchor the powered grinder, insert at least five whole raw logs and start it.
After the existing ten-plus-five-second cycle, collect one chip batch per five logs. Unpaid remainders stay installed.
Hold the chips and apply them to an adjacent oven-family structure to refuel it.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.conditions: Five logs produce one abstract batch containing five log units of feedstock, not a physical yield measurement. Ten batches per stack. Power/ownership/input checks must succeed at completion; observed power loss or cancellation gives no output. Chips cannot replace logs in crafting or convert back to logs.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.map_notes: Wizard Boy retains its mapped base grinder in maps/special/wizard_boy.dmm and its camp catalog. The global catalog can build a constructed wood grinder under Electricity; no recipe in camp, Carib or species overrides and no map-level resource reachability guarantee.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.era: Mapped base grinder: no added machine research gate. Constructed variant: Electricity node (era tier 5), maximum recipe era 8; existing baseline grants apply.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.status: Source-reviewed candidate; offline transaction checks passed; native gameplay and save/load unverified

/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.name: Fuel an oven with chip batches
steps: Hold a chip stack in hand and use it on an adjacent oven, campfire or wood stove.
Each paid batch supplies five existing oven fuel units and five paid-wood residue units, equal to its five input logs.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.conditions: Consumes held whole batches once before assigning fuel or residue credit. Loading creates no ash; the existing paid-fuel burn ledger governs residue. No other fuel family or pulp recipe added.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.map_notes: Requires an accessible existing oven-family structure and chip stock; no map-level reachability guarantee.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.era: No new fuel-specific era/research gate; station availability remains separate.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.status: Source-reviewed candidate; offline raw-log parity checks passed; native burn and save/load unverified

/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.name: Use a constructed wood grinder
steps: Build the wood grinder from a required 20 electronics; ordinary debit is 20 and Production debit is 18.
Anchor the initially empty, off machine, connect paid cable supply and insert at least five raw logs.
To relocate, remove cables and unfasten it; constructed machines cannot be dismantled for materials.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.conditions: Existing global catalog only; Electricity completed or supplied by baseline-era rules. Base 120-ds construction time is scaled by strength and crafting. No new grinder skill gate. Circuit crafting requires coefficient >= 2.2 plus copper and iron; input costs are nominal because bulk discounts apply. All grinder transaction and chip/fuel behavior is inherited unchanged.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.map_notes: Wizard Boy mapped base grinder and camp catalog unchanged; no new Carib, camp or species recipe. Existing steam engine plus two lit heatsources is a source-backed 30-capacity option, not a native or full-map guarantee.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.era: Electricity node era tier 5, minimum bench tier 4, Steam Power prerequisite and cable prototype; maximum recipe era 8. No new calendar-year/minimum-era gate.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.status: Source-reviewed candidate; offline acquisition checks passed; native construction, inventory, power network and save/load unverified

/obj/item/weapon/clay/mold/claypot/fired.name: Melt metal in a kiln
steps: Put ore or metal into a fired clay blacksmith pot or jug: copper ore for copper, copper and tin ore together for bronze, iron for iron, steel for steel.

recipes.name: Load, twist and counter-lay flax rope
recipes.conditions: Combine four bundles of the same yarn material into one held stack before loading an empty anchored hand ropewalk. Apply matching yarn stacks to each other to combine them. Materials cannot be mixed. Use for 100 ticks to twist four strands under tension, then use again for 100 ticks to lay them together in the opposite direction. Four yarn bundles represent equal-length groups of yarn, not four individual threads. Four output coils are game units. Recover paid unfinished work by dragging the frame onto yourself. A twisted batch resumes at counter-laying. Output is ordinary rope for existing consumers. Grass crude twine, sinew, tow twine and direct raw-plant recipes remain available.
recipes.era_basis: Station construction research: resource_processing; Required research: basic_tools

/obj/item/hemp_rope_bundle.desc: Two paid portions of hemp. Use on fresh water to ret; then load into a hemp dressing bench to dry, break, scutch and comb. Right-click a submerged bundle and choose Recover Hemp Bundle with a free hand to recover it and cancel retting, even in unsuitable water.

/obj/item/hull_plate.name: hull plate
/obj/item/hull_plate.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/hull_plate.title: hull armour plate
/obj/item/hull_plate.desc: A curved plate of layered steel and padding. Fit it to a habitat module's core to stop one strike of debris or a meteorite. A module takes three.

/obj/item/kitchen/wood_bowl.name: wood bowl
/obj/item/kitchen/wood_bowl.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ

/obj/item/lightbulb.name: lightbulb
/obj/item/lightbulb.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ

/obj/item/lightbulb/tube.name: tube
/obj/item/lightbulb/tube.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/lightbulb/tube.title: light tube

/obj/item/lunar_kit.name: lunar kit
/obj/item/lunar_kit.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/lunar_kit.title: lunar surface kit
/obj/item/lunar_kit.desc: A packed crate for a short surface sortie: two pressure suits, four air tanks, a suit patch, a rover battery and food and water for two people for three days. Use it to unpack it.

/obj/item/mine/ap.name: ap
/obj/item/mine/ap.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/mine/ap.title: anti-personnel mine
/obj/item/mine/ap.desc: Useful for setting traps or for area denial.

/obj/item/mine/at.name: at
/obj/item/mine/at.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/mine/at.title: anti-tank mine
/obj/item/mine/at.desc: Useful for setting traps or for area denial.

/obj/item/naval_mine.name: naval mine
/obj/item/naval_mine.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/naval_mine.title: contact mine
/obj/item/naval_mine.desc: A steel sphere of explosive with lead horns, a sinker and a mooring cable. Lay it on open water from a deck or the shore; any hull that runs onto it sets it off.

/obj/item/naval_mine/magnetic.name: magnetic
/obj/item/naval_mine/magnetic.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/naval_mine/magnetic.title: magnetic mine
/obj/item/naval_mine/magnetic.desc: A squat steel cylinder of explosive with a magnetic pistol in its nose. Lay it on open water from a deck or the shore; it waits for a steel hull and goes off under her keel. Wooden hulls do not set it off.

/obj/item/naval_torpedo.name: naval torpedo
/obj/item/naval_torpedo.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/naval_torpedo.title: torpedo
/obj/item/naval_torpedo.desc: A long steel fish of explosive, compressed air and gyroscope, with a contact pistol in its nose. Load it into a torpedo tube.

/obj/item/naval_torpedo/magnetic.name: magnetic
/obj/item/naval_torpedo/magnetic.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/naval_torpedo/magnetic.title: magnetic torpedo
/obj/item/naval_torpedo/magnetic.desc: A long steel fish of explosive, compressed air and gyroscope, with a magnetic pistol that also fires under a steel hull it passes close to. Load it into a torpedo tube.

/obj/item/orbital_shell.name: orbital shell
/obj/item/orbital_shell.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/orbital_shell.desc: A finned, heat-shielded shell for an orbital battery. It falls from orbit on its own; the battery only aims it.

/obj/item/overwatch_laptop.name: overwatch laptop
/obj/item/overwatch_laptop.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/overwatch_laptop.desc: A rugged laptop that shows what your own people's helmet cameras see. Leaders only. Keep it in hand and stand still while you watch.

/obj/item/pressure_suit_patch.name: pressure suit patch
/obj/item/pressure_suit_patch.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/pressure_suit_patch.title: suit patch kit
/obj/item/pressure_suit_patch.desc: Adhesive patches and sealant for a torn pressure suit. Use it on the suit, or on someone wearing one.

/obj/item/pressure_tank.name: pressure tank
/obj/item/pressure_tank.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/pressure_tank.title: suit air tank
/obj/item/pressure_tank.desc: A compressed-air bottle that feeds a sealed pressure suit. Wear it on your back. Refill it at a habitat module's core or a landed lander.

/obj/item/pressure_tank/diving.name: diving
/obj/item/pressure_tank/diving.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/pressure_tank/diving.title: diving air bottle
/obj/item/pressure_tank/diving.desc: Compressed air for a diving helmet. Wear it on your back. Refill it at a submarine's ballast station, a habitat module's core or a landed lander.

/obj/item/rope_spindle.name: rope spindle
/obj/item/rope_spindle.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/rope_spindle.title: hand spindle
/obj/item/rope_spindle.desc: Spins one portion of dressed hemp or flax tow into one bundle of rope yarn. Hold the spindle and fibres in opposite hands and use it on the fibres.

/obj/item/sail.name: sail
/obj/item/sail.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/sail.title: small cloth sail
/obj/item/sail.desc: A small cloth sail. Will fit a minor boat.

/obj/item/sail/wool.name: wool
/obj/item/sail/wool.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/sail/wool.title: small wool sail
/obj/item/sail/wool.desc: A small cloth sail. Will fit a minor boat.

/obj/item/satellite/comms.name: comms
/obj/item/satellite/comms.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/satellite/comms.title: comms satellite
/obj/item/satellite/comms.desc: A transponder that carries long-range radio between relays. Relays near its ground station need no antenna and wear half as fast.

/obj/item/satellite/navigation.name: navigation
/obj/item/satellite/navigation.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/satellite/navigation.title: navigation satellite
/obj/item/satellite/navigation.desc: A timing beacon. Once one is up, GPS receivers in this world can find themselves.

/obj/item/satellite/spy.name: spy
/obj/item/satellite/spy.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/satellite/spy.title: spy satellite
/obj/item/satellite/spy.desc: A long-lens camera that photographs the ground as it passes over. Its ground station shows rival stations, launch pads, vehicles and gatherings outdoors.

/obj/item/satellite/survey.name: survey
/obj/item/satellite/survey.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/satellite/survey.title: survey orbiter
/obj/item/satellite/survey.desc: A mapping camera that circles another world. Flown to the Moon or Mars, it maps the whole surface for a mission console and picks flat landing sites.

/obj/item/satellite/weather.name: weather
/obj/item/satellite/weather.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/satellite/weather.title: weather satellite
/obj/item/satellite/weather.desc: Cameras and a radiometer that watch the sky from orbit. A ground station reads its forecasts.

/obj/item/sector_beacon.name: sector beacon
/obj/item/sector_beacon.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/sector_beacon.desc: A survey transmitter and a bundle of marker lines. In orbit, carry it to the edge of your station's plane and switch it on to claim the space beyond for a new sector.

/obj/item/shamisen.name: shamisen
/obj/item/shamisen.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ

/obj/item/shellfish.name: shellfish
/obj/item/shellfish.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/shellfish.desc: A fresh, closed shellfish. You need a knife to open it.

/obj/item/sorbent_cartridge.name: sorbent cartridge
/obj/item/sorbent_cartridge.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/sorbent_cartridge.desc: A packed canister of lithium hydroxide and amine beads. Swap it into a CO2 scrubber when its bed is spent.

/obj/item/space_probe.name: space probe
/obj/item/space_probe.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/space_probe.title: survey probe
/obj/item/space_probe.desc: A small lander with a camera mast, a sample drill and a tiny ascent stage. Load it on a launch rail.

/obj/item/space_probe/advanced.name: advanced
/obj/item/space_probe/advanced.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/item/space_probe/advanced.title: advanced survey probe
/obj/item/space_probe/advanced.desc: A survey lander with a bigger battery, a stronger relay, a wide camera and room for five samples. Load it on a launch rail.

/obj/structure/berth/deck.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ

/obj/structure/berth/deck.desc: A capstan and a pair of davits for a ship's boat. Built on a ship's deck, it hoists a boat lying in the water nearby into the cradle of deck ahead of it and lowers it again. Click it to hoist, lower, turn the cradle or set its size.

/obj/structure/berth/quay.name: quay
/obj/structure/berth/quay.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/berth/quay.title: mooring post

/obj/structure/berth/quay/depot.name: depot

/obj/structure/car_workshop.name: car workshop
/obj/structure/car_workshop.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/car_workshop.title: automobile workshop
/obj/structure/car_workshop.desc: An electric metalworking and assembly press. Feed steel, glass, cloth, cable and four unattached wheels. It builds a car in the clear square northeast of the press. Finished cars need fuel.

/obj/structure/car_workshop/hangar.name: hangar
/obj/structure/car_workshop/hangar.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/car_workshop/hangar.title: aircraft hangar
/obj/structure/car_workshop/hangar.desc: An assembly press and jig for light airframes. Feed steel, glass, cloth, cable and four unattached wheels. It builds an aircraft in the clear square northeast of the press. Finished aircraft need fuel and room for a takeoff roll.

/obj/structure/car_workshop/rover_bay.name: rover bay
/obj/structure/car_workshop/rover_bay.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/car_workshop/rover_bay.title: rover assembly bay
/obj/structure/car_workshop/rover_bay.desc: A rover assembly press. Feed steel, glass, cloth, cable and four unattached wheels. It builds a rover in the clear square northeast of the press, with a charged battery.

/obj/structure/car_workshop/shipyard.name: shipyard
/obj/structure/car_workshop/shipyard.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/car_workshop/shipyard.title: shipyard office
/obj/structure/car_workshop/shipyard.desc: The drawing office and slipway press of a naval shipyard. Feed it steel, glass and cable. It lays an aircraft carrier down on the open deep sea to the north-east of this spot, with a level below for the hangar deck and open sky above for the island.

/obj/structure/car_workshop/submarine_pe.name: submarine pen
/obj/structure/car_workshop/submarine_pe.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/car_workshop/submarine_pe.desc: A covered slipway and riveting press. Feed it steel, glass and cable. It launches a submarine into the clear square of deep sea northeast of the press: 5x5 for a Scout, 7x7 for an Explorer. The boat leaves with an empty diesel tank.

/obj/structure/cargo_hold.name: cargo hold
/obj/structure/cargo_hold.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/cargo_hold.desc: A steel cargo box made to bolt onto a vehicle bed. It rides with the vehicle and holds twenty items, bulky ones included. Feeder arms can load and unload it. Use a wrench to bolt or unbolt it.

/obj/structure/catapult.name: catapult

/obj/structure/cell_tower.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ

/obj/structure/centrifuge.name: centrifuge
/obj/structure/centrifuge.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/centrifuge.title: laboratory centrifuge
/obj/structure/centrifuge.desc: A professional laboratory centrifuge, used to separate chemicals in a solution.

/obj/structure/chart_helm/orbit.name: orbit
/obj/structure/chart_helm/orbit.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/chart_helm/orbit.title: orbital helm
/obj/structure/chart_helm/orbit.desc: The orbit chart and the engine controls of a spacecraft. Set on the floor of a habitat module, it flies that module and every module docked to it.

/obj/structure/chem_master/tablet_press/.name: tablet press

/obj/structure/chemical_dispenser/full/l.title: laboratory feedstock dispenser
/obj/structure/chemical_dispenser/full/l.desc: A finite starter supply of game laboratory feedstocks; refill it with reagent containers.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/fuel_cell.name: fuel cell
/obj/structure/civ_generator/fuel_cell.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/fuel_cell.desc: Burns hydrogen and oxygen into steady power and keeps the water it makes. Pour both in, cable it and switch it on; empty a container on it to draw the water.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/isotope.name: isotope
/obj/structure/civ_generator/isotope.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/isotope.title: radioisotope generator
/obj/structure/civ_generator/isotope.desc: A shielded core of decaying isotope ringed with thermocouples. It gives steady power through sunlight and shade, with nothing to feed it. Cable it and switch it on.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/nuclear.name: nuclear
/obj/structure/civ_generator/nuclear.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/nuclear.title: controlled reactor generator
/obj/structure/civ_generator/nuclear.desc: A finite-fuel generator with coolant, controls and maintenance. Heat is local; this machine never changes global radiation.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar.name: solar
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar.title: solar array controller
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar.desc: Controls an integrated photovoltaic array. Outdoor daylight supplies the cable grid; storage must be charged before night.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/panel.name: panel
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/panel.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/panel.title: photovoltaic panel
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/panel.desc: A single framed photovoltaic module on a steel stand. Outdoor daylight supplies a little power to the cable grid; nothing at night.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing.name: wing
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing.title: fixed solar wing
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing.desc: A rigid wing of photovoltaic cells on a short boom. In orbit it charges the grid only while the station is in sunlight.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing/.name: tracking
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing/.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing/.title: tracking solar array
/obj/structure/civ_generator/solar/wing/.desc: Two wide photovoltaic wings on a gimbal that keeps them square to the sun. In orbit it charges the grid only while the station is in sunlight.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/waterwheel.name: waterwheel
/obj/structure/civ_generator/waterwheel.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/waterwheel.title: waterwheel generator
/obj/structure/civ_generator/waterwheel.desc: A paddle wheel and dynamo on timber trestles. Build it from the bank into flowing water, then cable it back to shore.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/charge.name: charger
/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/charge.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/charge.title: wind charger
/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/charge.desc: A many-bladed rotor and dynamo on a steel lattice tower, like the interwar chargers that lit remote homesteads. It furls in a gale.

/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/turbin.name: turbine
/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/turbin.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/turbin.title: wind turbine
/obj/structure/civ_generator/wind/turbin.desc: A three-bladed utility turbine on a tubular tower. Pitch control keeps it at full output even in a gale.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/chest.name: chest
/obj/structure/closet/crate/chest.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/chest.title: crate (chest)

/obj/structure/closet/crate/dumpster.name: dumpster
/obj/structure/closet/crate/dumpster.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/dumpster.desc: A dumpster for all your trash and bodies.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/empty.name: empty
/obj/structure/closet/crate/empty.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/empty.title: wood crate

/obj/structure/closet/crate/empty/large.name: large
/obj/structure/closet/crate/empty/large.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/empty/large.title: large crate

/obj/structure/closet/crate/factory_bin.name: factory bin
/obj/structure/closet/crate/factory_bin.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/factory_bin.title: parts bin
/obj/structure/closet/crate/factory_bin.desc: A steel crate for a production line. Once it holds something it only accepts more of the same kind.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/footlocker.name: footlocker
/obj/structure/closet/crate/footlocker.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ

/obj/structure/closet/crate/large.name: large
/obj/structure/closet/crate/large.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/large.title: large crate

/obj/structure/closet/crate/lead.name: lead
/obj/structure/closet/crate/lead.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/lead.title: lead safe
/obj/structure/closet/crate/lead.desc: A large lead safe, good to store radioactive things.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/rover_traile.name: rover trailer
/obj/structure/closet/crate/rover_traile.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/rover_traile.title: cargo trailer
/obj/structure/closet/crate/rover_traile.desc: A wheeled cargo bed with a hitch. Load it like a crate, then hitch it to a rover or car beside it to tow it.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/travois.name: travois
/obj/structure/closet/crate/travois.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/travois.desc: Two long poles lashed into a drag, with a hide platform between them. Pull it to haul a load across country.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/wall_mailbox.name: wall mailbox
/obj/structure/closet/crate/wall_mailbox.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/wall_mailbox.desc: A mail box fastened on walls.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/wall_mailbox.name: wood mailbox
/obj/structure/closet/crate/wall_mailbox.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/wall_mailbox.desc: A wood box with a slot to accept mail.

/obj/structure/closet/crate/ww2.name: ww2
/obj/structure/closet/crate/ww2.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/crate/ww2.title: military crate

/obj/structure/closet/fridge.name: fridge
/obj/structure/closet/fridge.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/closet/fridge.title: refrigerator

/obj/structure/component_workbench.name: component workbench
/obj/structure/component_workbench.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/component_workbench.title: tool assembly workbench
/obj/structure/component_workbench.desc: Select a tool, insert its head and a handle, then assemble it. Inputs and finished tools can be retrieved.

/obj/structure/component_workbench/armor.name: armor
/obj/structure/component_workbench/armor.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/component_workbench/armor.title: armor assembly workbench
/obj/structure/component_workbench/armor.desc: Select a recipe, insert its listed materials or components, and assemble. Retrieve returns all stored inputs or the finished item.

/obj/structure/component_workbench/fletc.name: fletching
/obj/structure/component_workbench/fletc.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/component_workbench/fletc.title: fletcher's bench
/obj/structure/component_workbench/fletc.desc: Select arrows or crossbow bolts, load shafts and arrowheads or sharpened flint, then fletch them all at once. Finished ammunition is left beside the bench.

/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.name: toolsmith
/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.title: toolsmith's bench
/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.desc: Select a tool, load smelted metal and soft wood, and work beside an anvil to make finished tools in one step. Slower than smithing a head and fitting a handle; finished tools are left beside the bench.

/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.name: foundry
/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.title: casting foundry
/obj/structure/component_workbench/tools.desc: Select a tool, set down a pot or jug of molten metal and load soft wood, then cast finished tools in batches. Finished tools are left beside the foundry.

/obj/structure/component_workbench/weapo.name: weapon
/obj/structure/component_workbench/weapo.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/component_workbench/weapo.title: weapon assembly workbench
/obj/structure/component_workbench/weapo.desc: Select a weapon, insert its head and a handle, then assemble it. Inputs and finished weapons can be retrieved.

/obj/structure/compost.name: compost
/obj/structure/compost.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/compost.title: compost bin
/obj/structure/compost.desc: A wood box, used to turn trash and scraps into fertilizer.

/obj/structure/converter/acid_bath.name: acid bath
/obj/structure/converter/acid_bath.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/converter/acid_bath.title: industrial acidic bath
/obj/structure/converter/acid_bath.desc: Soaks man-made fibres over time into usuable material. It would not be big or deep enough to fit say... a human body inside.

/obj/structure/converter/retting_trough.name: retting trough
/obj/structure/converter/retting_trough.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/converter/retting_trough.desc: Soaks fibrous plants over time into retted fabric. Requires at least two separate hemp or flax at a time.

/obj/structure/converter/tanning.name: tanning rack
/obj/structure/converter/tanning.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/converter/tanning.desc: Dries a stack of washed hides in 30 seconds. Remove it by hand to cancel; apply bark tannin to the dried hides afterward.

/obj/structure/crewed_lander.name: crewed lander
/obj/structure/crewed_lander.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/crewed_lander.desc: A squat craft with seats for four and a small sealed cabin. Fill it with rocket propellant beside an approved launch pad, strap in on its tile and launch.

/obj/structure/crewed_lander/freighter.name: freighter
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/freighter.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/freighter.title: cargo freighter
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/freighter.desc: An uncrewed rocket with a cargo hold and no seats. Load the hold, fill it with rocket propellant or methalox beside an approved launch pad and launch it: the cargo lands at your party's station in orbit, or by your launch complex office on another world.

/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.name: orbital rocket
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.title: two-stage rocket
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.desc: A tall two-stage rocket with a three-seat capsule on top. Fill it with rocket propellant beside an approved launch pad to orbit, strap in on its tile and launch.

/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.name: reusable
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.title: reusable rocket
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/orbital_roc.desc: A crew ship with eight seats on a booster that lands itself again. Fill it with rocket propellant or methalox beside a launch pad pointed at orbit, strap in on its tile and launch; the booster comes back to the pad.

/obj/structure/crewed_lander/satellite_l.name: satellite launcher
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/satellite_l.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/crewed_lander/satellite_l.desc: A slim uncrewed rocket with a payload fairing for one satellite. Load a satellite, fill it with rocket propellant or methalox beside an approved launch pad and launch it.

/obj/structure/cross.name: cross
/obj/structure/cross.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/cross.title: greek cross

/obj/structure/cross/tau.name: tau
/obj/structure/cross/tau.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/cross/tau.title: tau cross

/obj/structure/curtain.name: curtain
/obj/structure/curtain.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ

/obj/structure/curtain/leather.name: leather
/obj/structure/curtain/leather.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/curtain/leather.title: leather curtain

/obj/structure/cutting_board.name: cutting board
/obj/structure/cutting_board.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/cutting_board.desc: A wood board used to prepare food.

/obj/structure/degaussing_coil.name: degaussing coil
/obj/structure/degaussing_coil.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/degaussing_coil.desc: Heavy copper cable wound on a steel frame, with a switch box. Set it on a steel ship's deck and switch it on to hide most of her magnetic field from magnetic mines. It needs power while she moves: her engine, or her battery on a submarine.

/obj/structure/dehydrator.name: dehydrator
/obj/structure/dehydrator.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/dehydrator.desc: A wood structure used to dry meat, fish, tobacco, and so on.

/obj/structure/display_case.name: display case
/obj/structure/display_case.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/display_case.desc: A glass case for showing off one prized item. A key can lock it.

/obj/structure/distillery.name: distillery
/obj/structure/distillery.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/distillery.title: alcohol distiller
/obj/structure/distillery.desc: A alcohol distiller. Turns any alcoholic drink into pure ethanol.

/obj/structure/docking_port.name: docking port
/obj/structure/docking_port.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/docking_port.desc: A ferry collar with a hatch for visiting crews and a small cargo hatch for parcels. Its station's owners choose who may dock.

/obj/structure/drill.name: drill
/obj/structure/drill.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drill.title: industrial drill
/obj/structure/drill.desc: A heavy industrial deep drill used to collect minerals that are hidden far underground. Requires 150 cable power and uncovered dirt, on the surface or underground. Produces 2 minerals every two minutes. Clear the output tile before it reaches 12 stacks.

/obj/structure/drill/fracking.name: fracking
/obj/structure/drill/fracking.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drill/fracking.title: hydraulic fracturing rig
/obj/structure/drill/fracking.desc: A Modern rig. Anchor beside mineable underground rock, connect 300 cable power, and load a freshwater barrel, an empty petroleum barrel and raw sand. A two-minute batch consumes one rock tile, 20 water and 5 sand for 50 petroleum. Each batch stops the rig.

/obj/structure/drill/regolith_rig.name: regolith rig
/obj/structure/drill/regolith_rig.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drill/regolith_rig.title: regolith drill rig
/obj/structure/drill/regolith_rig.desc: A light drill rig built for barren ground. Requires 60 cable power and open regolith. Produces 2 pieces of ore, sand or ice every two minutes. Clear the output tile before it reaches 12 stacks.

/obj/structure/drill/sifter.name: sifter
/obj/structure/drill/sifter.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drill/sifter.title: powered soil sifter
/obj/structure/drill/sifter.desc: Separates trace resources from uncovered non-mineable dirt or sand. Requires 150 cable power and anchoring. Produces two random trace units every two minutes; clear its output before twelve stacks accumulate.

/obj/structure/drill/sifter/panner.name: panner
/obj/structure/drill/sifter/panner.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drill/sifter/panner.title: powered river concentrator
/obj/structure/drill/sifter/panner.desc: Concentrates trace river sediment on uncovered non-mineable dirt or sand beside shallow freshwater. Requires 150 cable power and anchoring. Produces two random copper, tin, silver or gold ore units every two minutes; clear its output before twelve stacks accumulate.

/obj/structure/drill/stamp_mill.name: stamp mill
/obj/structure/drill/stamp_mill.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drill/stamp_mill.title: powered stamp mill
/obj/structure/drill/stamp_mill.desc: Electric stamps pound loaded stone blocks and wash out sand, ore and minerals. Anchor it, connect 150 cable power and load up to fifty stone blocks. It crushes one stone every four seconds with better recovery than a hand crusher; clear its output before twelve stacks accumulate.

/obj/structure/drone/flying.name: flying
/obj/structure/drone/flying.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drone/flying.title: drone

/obj/structure/drone/flying/grenade.name: grenade
/obj/structure/drone/flying/grenade.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drone/flying/grenade.title: drone
/obj/structure/drone/flying/grenade.desc: A flying drone. This one is capable of carrying and releasing grenades.

/obj/structure/drying_rack.name: drying rack
/obj/structure/drying_rack.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/drying_rack.desc: A large iron drying rack, used to dry hams and other food products.

/obj/structure/engine/external/steam.name: steam
/obj/structure/engine/external/steam.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/engine/external/steam.title: steam engine
/obj/structure/engine/external/steam.desc: A big steam-powered engine. Low Power-To-Weight ratio, but good for static operations.

/obj/structure/exercise.name: exercise
/obj/structure/exercise.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/exercise.title: stone lifting weights
/obj/structure/exercise.desc: Crafted stone weights. With an empty active hand, click for each of three fifteen-second repetitions. Stay still to finish each repetition; interruption or cancelling loses the unfinished set. Stone weights train strength below 125; fatigue can require a rest.

/obj/structure/exercise/course.name: course
/obj/structure/exercise/course.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/exercise/course.title: agility and endurance course marker
/obj/structure/exercise/course.desc: A manually walked square course: start on this tile, then visit three tiles east, three north, three west and back south to the start. Use Exercise Step at each corner for a timed repetition.

/obj/structure/exercise/modern.name: modern
/obj/structure/exercise/modern.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/exercise/modern.title: gym lifting weights
/obj/structure/exercise/modern.desc: Machined lifting weights. With an empty active hand, click for each of three fifteen-second repetitions. Stay still to finish each repetition. These weights train strength below 150; fatigue can require a rest.

/obj/structure/exercise/modern/course.name: course
/obj/structure/exercise/modern/course.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/exercise/modern/course.title: gym circuit marker
/obj/structure/exercise/modern/course.desc: A Modern agility and endurance circuit. Walk the four corners of its three-tile square and complete Exercise Step at each corner.

/obj/structure/factory_arm.name: factory arm
/obj/structure/factory_arm.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_arm.title: feeder arm
/obj/structure/factory_arm.desc: A powered swing arm. It lifts one item at a time from the tile behind it and sets it down on the tile in front: onto a belt, into a crate or machine, or onto the floor. Cable it, then switch it on. While it is off, use the Rotate verbs to turn it, or a wrench to fasten or unfasten it.

/obj/structure/factory_arm/sorting.name: sorting
/obj/structure/factory_arm/sorting.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_arm/sorting.title: sorting arm
/obj/structure/factory_arm/sorting.desc: A powered swing arm that only moves one kind of item. Hit it with an item to set its filter; use the Clear Filter verb to reset it. Cable it, then switch it on. While it is off, use the Rotate verbs to turn it, or a wrench to fasten or unfasten it.

/obj/structure/factory_arm/stack.name: stack
/obj/structure/factory_arm/stack.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_arm/stack.title: stack arm
/obj/structure/factory_arm/stack.desc: A heavy powered swing arm that moves up to ten items of one kind each swing. Hit it with an item to make it move only that kind; use the Clear Filter verb to let it move anything. Cable it, then switch it on. While it is off, use the Rotate verbs to turn it, or a wrench to fasten or unfasten it.

/obj/structure/factory_drive.name: factory drive
/obj/structure/factory_drive.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_drive.title: belt drive
/obj/structure/factory_drive.desc: A motor and gearbox that runs every factory belt within seven tiles. Cable it, then switch it on. Belts out of range of a running drive stand still.

/obj/structure/factory_fabricator.name: factory fabricator
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator.title: assembly fabricator
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator.desc: A powered machine that turns parts fed by arms and belts into goods from the factory recipe list. Set its recipe by hand; cable it to run. Output is left in front of it on its own tile.

/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/automa.name: automated
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/automa.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/automa.title: automated fabricator
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/automa.desc: A powered machine that turns parts fed by arms and belts into goods from the factory recipe list. Set its recipe by hand; cable it to run. Output is left in front of it on its own tile.

/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/comput.name: computerized
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/comput.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/comput.title: computerized fabricator
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/comput.desc: A powered machine that turns parts fed by arms and belts into goods from the factory recipe list. Set its recipe by hand; cable it to run. Output is left in front of it on its own tile.

/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/printe.name: printer
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/printe.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/printe.title: 3D printer
/obj/structure/factory_fabricator/printe.desc: An additive manufacturing printer that builds plastic goods layer by layer. Set what it prints by hand, then load plastic by hand or with arms and belts. Cable it to run; prints are left in front of it.

/obj/structure/factory_monitor.name: factory monitor
/obj/structure/factory_monitor.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/factory_monitor.desc: A terminal wired to the machines around it. It shows what each arm, fabricator and belt drive within seven tiles is doing, how many items it moves or makes a minute, and how much power it draws.

/obj/structure/filingcabinet.name: filingcabinet
/obj/structure/filingcabinet.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/filingcabinet.title: filing cabinet

/obj/structure/filingcabinet/chestdrawer.name: chestdrawer
/obj/structure/filingcabinet/chestdrawer.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/filingcabinet/chestdrawer.title: chest drawer

/obj/structure/filingcabinet/chestdrawer.name: wooden document drawers
/obj/structure/filingcabinet/chestdrawer.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/filingcabinet/chestdrawer.desc: Peg-joined wooden drawers for papers, paper bundles and folders.

/obj/structure/filingcabinet/filingcabin.name: filingcabinet
/obj/structure/filingcabinet/filingcabin.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/filingcabinet/filingcabin.title: filing cabinet (filingcabinet)

/obj/structure/fire_pump.name: fire pump
/obj/structure/fire_pump.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fire_pump.title: hand pump fire engine
/obj/structure/fire_pump.desc: A water tub on wheels with a hand pump and a leather hose. Fill it by bucket, pull it to the fire, then take the nozzle and aim.

/obj/structure/fire_pump/reel.name: reel
/obj/structure/fire_pump/reel.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fire_pump/reel.title: fire hose reel
/obj/structure/fire_pump/reel.desc: A canvas fire hose wound on a drum. It draws its water from a sink or well beside it.

/obj/structure/fish_pen.name: fish pen
/obj/structure/fish_pen.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fish_pen.desc: A ring of wooden stakes for keeping fish. Push it into fresh water, stock it with raw fish you have caught and feed it grain, seeds or meat scraps; the fish breed. Catch them back out with a fishing pole or net.

/obj/structure/fishing_cage.name: fishing cage
/obj/structure/fishing_cage.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fishing_cage.desc: A wooden fishing cage trap, used to get deep-sea lobsters, crabs, fish, etc.

/obj/structure/flag/pole.name: pole
/obj/structure/flag/pole.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/flag/pole.title: Flagpole
/obj/structure/flag/pole.desc: Flagless, apply cloth or a flag.

/obj/structure/flax_comb.name: flax comb
/obj/structure/flax_comb.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/flax_comb.desc: A wooden comb for separating rotted flax. Load up to ten portions, then use by hand to separate straw, tow and textile lint. Drag it onto yourself to recover an unfinished batch.

/obj/structure/fluid_bottler.name: fluid bottler
/obj/structure/fluid_bottler.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_bottler.title: bottler
/obj/structure/fluid_bottler.desc: A pipe-fed filling cradle. Belts and arms bring it open containers; it fills each with its one reagent from the pipe network and hands it back once full. Hold a filled container and use Set Bottler Reagent to choose that reagent.

/obj/structure/fluid_intake.name: fluid intake
/obj/structure/fluid_intake.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_intake.title: water intake
/obj/structure/fluid_intake.desc: A screened pipe inlet. Set beside open water, it supplies that water to its pipe network.

/obj/structure/fluid_meter.name: fluid meter
/obj/structure/fluid_meter.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_meter.title: pipe meter
/obj/structure/fluid_meter.desc: A gauge clamped onto a pipe. Examine it or use it to read its pipe network: pumps, flow and every machine on the line. It lights while liquid moves.

/obj/structure/fluid_pipe.name: fluid pipe
/obj/structure/fluid_pipe.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_pipe.desc: A steel pipe. It joins with pipes and machines on every side. A network only moves liquids while a powered pump is connected to it.

/obj/structure/fluid_pipe/valve.name: valve
/obj/structure/fluid_pipe/valve.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_pipe/valve.title: pipe valve
/obj/structure/fluid_pipe/valve.desc: A steel pipe with a hand valve. Closed, it joins nothing and splits the network in two. Click it to open or close it.

/obj/structure/fluid_pump.name: fluid pump
/obj/structure/fluid_pump.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_pump.desc: An electric pump. Set next to a pipe and cabled, it moves liquids through that pipe network while switched on.

/obj/structure/fluid_tablet_press.name: fluid tablet press
/obj/structure/fluid_tablet_press.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_tablet_press.title: automatic tablet press
/obj/structure/fluid_tablet_press.desc: A powered press fed by pipes. It draws calcium carbonate and aspirin into an inert buffer and presses one aspirin tablet a step onto its tile for arms to take.

/obj/structure/fluid_tank.name: fluid tank
/obj/structure/fluid_tank.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_tank.title: holding tank
/obj/structure/fluid_tank.desc: A fixed steel tank for a pipe network. It fills from sources and feeds machines that want what it holds. Hold a container and use Set Tank Filter to keep it to one reagent. Its contents are held inert.

/obj/structure/fluid_vessel.name: fluid vessel
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel.title: reaction vessel
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel.desc: A powered steel vessel for a pipe network. Choose a laboratory recipe and it draws a full batch of that recipe's inputs, reacts them, then lets the result out to the network. Its contents are held inert otherwise.

/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/fast.name: fast
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/fast.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/fast.title: fast reaction vessel
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/fast.desc: A powered steel vessel for a pipe network. Choose a laboratory recipe and it draws a full batch of that recipe's inputs, reacts them, then lets the result out to the network. Its contents are held inert otherwise.

/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/industrial.name: industrial
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/industrial.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/industrial.title: industrial reaction vessel
/obj/structure/fluid_vessel/industrial.desc: A powered steel vessel for a pipe network. Choose a laboratory recipe and it draws a full batch of that recipe's inputs, reacts them, then lets the result out to the network. Its contents are held inert otherwise.

/obj/structure/freight_dispatcher.name: freight dispatcher
/obj/structure/freight_dispatcher.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/freight_dispatcher.desc: A rugged control box with a cargo scanner. Beside a launch pad, it loads cargo freighters from crates next to it and launches them for its party once their hold is full, with nobody at the pad.

/obj/structure/fuelpump/n.name: n
/obj/structure/fuelpump/n.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fuelpump/n.title: fuel pump (n)
/obj/structure/fuelpump/n.desc: A fuel pump. You need to pay to use it.

/obj/structure/fuelpump/s.name: s
/obj/structure/fuelpump/s.label: Initial sprite; runtime appearance may differ
/obj/structure/fuelpump/s.title: fuel pump (s)
